screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
I loved you.
I just didn’t like your face that day.

Two bad moods.
One very small room.
We made each other’s hurt louder.

The anger was real.
So was the love.

A bad day was never
the whole truth about us.

director_storyboard.copy_lock_evidence: The exact six-slide copy and Instagram-post-only canvas were locked before the independent observable-card review.
director_storyboard.reviewer_evidence: A fresh critic with no forked context received only the repaired six observable blind cards. Without seeing copy, title, theme, intent, prompts, prior review, or package artifacts, the critic passed the tense-to-repair sequence and explicitly traced the board skid, taut lamp cord, lamp tip and key spill as one causal chain.

blind_cards.visible_setting: A narrow aisle inside one small room at rainy dusk; a table, glowing lamp, charger and water glass are visible.
blind_cards.observable_action: The woman and man squeeze past in opposite directions with faces turned away. The woman places the man's phone onto the charger while the man catches the woman's slipping water glass upright.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand contacts the phone; her left hand is pocketed. The man's left hand contacts the glass; his right hand is hidden behind his body. Their bodies do not touch.
blind_cards.gaze: Neither looks at the other; both faces turn away with tightened brows and mouths.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They occupy the same narrow aisle at the same depth with torsos angled in opposite directions.
blind_cards.object_state: Phone is placed on charger; water glass is caught upright; lamp is upright and lit; extension cord is slack.
blind_cards.camera_view: Chest-height compressed medium view from the doorway.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: Charcoal-and-ivory evening clothes are slightly rain-damp.

blind_cards.visible_setting: Beside the open wardrobe in the same room; warm lamp edge and cool window light cross the frame.
blind_cards.observable_action: The woman pulls her hair tie tight, pauses with a pinched facial expression, then loosens the tie slightly.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: Her right arm, wrist and hand remain visible and connected to the hair tie; her left hand is outside the crop.
blind_cards.gaze: Her eyes drop toward the floor after the pause.
blind_cards.body_blocking: Tight side profile; no other person, mirror or reflection is visible.
blind_cards.object_state: One hair tie changes from taut to slightly loosened; the wardrobe remains open.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: Same charcoal-grey blazer, ivory top and slightly damp shoulder as the previous frame.

blind_cards.visible_setting: The same tiny room seen from a ceiling corner; a low divan and small table leave one narrow aisle between them.
blind_cards.observable_action: The woman opens the wardrobe door into the aisle at the same moment the man rolls one chair backward into it. Both stop with only a hand-span of floor remaining.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand holds the wardrobe handle; her left arm is behind the door. The man's right hand rests on the chair back; his left hand rests on his thigh.
blind_cards.gaze: They look across the narrow remaining gap at each other.
blind_cards.body_blocking: The wardrobe door and chair occupy opposite diagonals and block the only path between the two people.
blind_cards.object_state: Wardrobe is open; chair is rolled back; lamp remains upright and lit; extension cord remains slack; an untouched meal sits on the table.
blind_cards.camera_view: Extreme overhead wide view from the ceiling corner.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: Same room, clothes, lamp, charger, bags, umbrella and meal.

blind_cards.visible_setting: Low table-level view in the same room; an extension board fills the lower foreground.
blind_cards.observable_action: The woman and man each drag one opposite plastic end of the same live extension board toward themselves at the same moment. The board rotates and skids diagonally, its taut black lamp cord lifts the intact lamp base mid-tip, and the moving board clips the key bowl so two keys spill along the impact direction.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's left shoulder, arm, wrist and hand connect to and grip only the board's left plastic end. The man's right shoulder, arm, wrist and hand connect to and grip only the board's right plastic end. Their other hands are outside the frame; neither visible hand holds a plug.
blind_cards.gaze: Both faces recoil toward the sliding board and tipping lamp; mouths are closed.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They lean in from opposite sides without crossing bodies or touching.
blind_cards.object_state: A white charger adapter and black lamp plug remain inserted in occupied sockets; both cables are taut in opposite directions; the board skids and rotates; the intact lamp lifts mid-tip; the struck bowl releases two keys; nothing breaks.
blind_cards.camera_view: Low obstructed close view with foreground consequence and faces behind.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: Same charcoal clothing, chair, untouched meal, lamp and extension board.

blind_cards.visible_setting: The same room in cool rainy near-darkness at floor height; the intact lamp rests on its side beside the extension board.
blind_cards.observable_action: The man lifts the lamp by its base while the woman pushes the lamp plug into the extension board. Warm light returns between them.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: The man's right hand owns the lamp base and his left hand rests on his thigh. The woman's left hand owns the plug and her right hand braces on the floor beside her knee. All four wrists and forearms remain visible.
blind_cards.gaze: Both keep set jaws and meet eyes only as the lamp lights.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They kneel at the same depth on opposite sides of the lamp with separate silhouettes.
blind_cards.object_state: Lamp changes from dark and sideways to supported and lit; plug becomes connected; cord becomes slack.
blind_cards.camera_view: Intimate floor-height three-quarter close insert with hands sharp and faces readable.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: Same creased charcoal-and-ivory wardrobe; no object is broken.

blind_cards.visible_setting: The same room seen from farther outside the doorway; rain remains at the window and the chair is still displaced.
blind_cards.observable_action: The woman and man sit shoulder-to-shoulder on the floor inside the lamp's warm pool. The woman offers the final piece of food and the man receives it.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand offers the food and her left hand rests on her knee. The man's left hand receives and his right hand rests on his own knee.
blind_cards.gaze: They meet eyes with tired neutral expressions rather than broad smiles.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They sit at the same depth with shoulders lightly touching and no embrace.
blind_cards.object_state: Lamp is upright and lit; extension cord is slack; wardrobe is closed; key bowl is settled; the previously untouched meal is nearly finished.
blind_cards.camera_view: Stable wide doorway reprise pulled farther back than the first frame.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: Same room disorder, bags, umbrella, clothes, lamp, cord and meal remain visible.

director_storyboard.physical_event: Two rain-damp people move around one cramped room, collide through separate tasks, drag opposite ends of the same live extension board until its taut lamp cord tips the lamp and the moving board spills keys, then restore the light together and finish their meal side by side.
director_storyboard.emotional_arc: Guarded residual care becomes private strain, spatial standoff, shared consequence, restrained cooperation, and quiet reconnection.
director_storyboard.relationship_change: Aachu and Zuv move from avoiding direct engagement while still caring reflexively to coordinating a repair and accepting a small final exchange.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: The fresh independent critic read the repaired full sequence without copy: automatic care inside visible tension, private self-regulation, mutual spatial obstruction, two opposing pulls on one live board causing the lamp and key-bowl consequence, equal practical repair, and subdued reconnection.

setup_payoff_ledger.setup: Slide 1 establishes an upright warm lamp, a slack cord, opposite-facing bodies, and residual care through the phone and glass.
setup_payoff_ledger.payoff: Slides 4 and 5 turn the cord taut, tip the lamp, darken the room, and then require complementary hands to restore the light.
setup_payoff_ledger.changed_meaning: A practical object becomes visible proof that their separate hurt amplifies the room and their equal cooperation can soften it without erasing anger.

setup_payoff_ledger.setup: Slide 3 leaves the meal untouched while the wardrobe door and chair make their separate movements incompatible.
setup_payoff_ledger.payoff: Slide 6 closes the wardrobe, leaves the chair honestly displaced, and shows the meal nearly finished as they exchange its last piece.
setup_payoff_ledger.changed_meaning: The room remains imperfect, but the couple has stopped treating shared space as a contest.

object_motif_ledger.story_job: Externalize the escalation and repair without melodrama, blame, or a generic embrace.

object_motif_ledger.later_state: The meal is nearly finished and its final piece passes between them.
object_motif_ledger.story_job: Show time and reconnection through ordinary domestic behavior rather than a declared resolution.
